title: Revise token contrast mappings and keyboard scenarios for compact charts and dense tables
creator: Liam O'Connor
description: Audit and adjust color token mappings used by compact-density charts and dense table row states so that touchpoints, small labels, and data-axis text meet WCAG contrast thresholds. Update keyboard interaction documentation and edge-case scenarios so assistive tech users can reliably navigate legends, selectable rows, and inline actions. Produce a short conformance report artifact for compliance that ties token changes to component test results.
acceptance_criteria: All affected components render in Storybook with new tokens and pass automated a11y checks (axe/lighthouse) without contrast failures for text >= 14pt and UI controls at 3:1 where applicable
Keyboard walkthrough doc added to component readmes describing tab order for charts, focus trapping in popovers, and ARIA attributes for selectable rows
Design token migration plan with mapping table and deprecation window published in confluence and linked PRs reference the plan
Manual verification checklist completed for: chart legends, zoom controls, table row selection, inline action buttons, and pagination controls
Conformance summary (one-page) created for legal/compliance containing before/after screenshots and test logs
tasks: Run contrast audit across current token set for compact chart variants (script + Storybook) — @Maya
Propose adjusted token values and alternatives (3 variants: conservative, balanced, aggressive) — @Maya + @Ravi
Update Chart token usage in Figma and produce new tokens.json export — @DesignOps
Create Storybook stories covering keyboard navigation scenarios for charts and tables — @Frontend
Open PR(s) that update CSS vars and component styles; include visual diffs — @Frontend
Coordinate with ENG to smoke-test Dedicated and Private builds where tokens are compiled differently — @PlatformEng
Publish conformance report and link in PR description — @Liam
decisions: Prefer slight hue shift over luminance drop where possible to preserve brand color intent
Adopt 3 token variants for each affected semantic token to allow runtime fallbacks (primary: default, alt: high-contrast, alt2: large-text-only)
Do not change spacing or control sizes in this ticket — focus is color/ARIA/keyboard only
steps_taken: Initial automated contrast run completed (axe + custom color-checker) on 2025-02-12; identified 18 failures across charts and tables
Design proposals created for conservative/balanced/aggressive token changes on 2025-02-18
Alignment review with Accessibility SME (Ravi Patel) on 2025-02-21; agreed on target thresholds and ARIA patterns
Prototype tokens applied to Storybook component snapshots on 2025-02-24 for visual verification
testing_notes: Manual keyboard script documented: tab order, shift-tab reversal, arrow navigation within chart legend, escape to close popovers
Screen reader pass done with NVDA and VoiceOver for table row selection scenarios — small issues noted with aria-rowheader labeling
Automated tests to be added to CI: storybook a11y snapshot gating + color-checker that validates contrast ratio thresholds
